dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts the 19 Pueblos of New Mexico, federal tenants who must be relocated, and the Indian Pueblo Cultural Center.
dimensions.evidence: takes three tracts of specified federal land (approximately 9.89 acres) in Albuquerque, New Mexico, into trust for the benefit of the 19 Pueblos of New Mexico.

dimensions.assessment: Permanently transfers jurisdictional ownership of land and fee title to structures for educational, health, cultural, business, and economic development use.
dimensions.evidence: used for the educational, health, cultural, business, and economic development of the 19 Pueblos

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state any federal spending or revenue effects beyond agency relocation and transfer logistics.
Executes a specific federal land transfer, agency jurisdiction reassignment, fee conveyance, and statutory gaming prohibition.
dimensions.evidence: transfer to the Secretary administrative jurisdiction over the Federal land... take into trust all right, title, and interest

dimensions.assessment: Executes a permanent land trust transfer and fee conveyance with lasting legal status.
dimensions.evidence: The Federal land taken into trust... shall be... subject to Federal laws applicable to Indian trust land

missing_information: Costs associated with relocating federal tenants and transferring administrative jurisdiction.
importance_detail.rationale: Transfers approximately 9.89 acres of federal land in Albuquerque from GSA to the Department of the Interior to be held in trust for the 19 Pueblos of New Mexico, conveys certain buildings in fee to the Indian Pueblo Cultural Center, and prohibits gaming on the land.
